text:
Priya (Growth): Quick kickoff: we need a single launch post + three landing copy variants (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), a webinar to convert mid-funnel, and an inbound routing matrix. Goal: capture intent and route efficiently.
Evan (PMM): Agreed. Draft thesis for the post: "Serving is the competitive edge" -> explain latency/cost/reliability tradeoffs, then link to mode pages. Keep it 3 short sections.
Lina (Content): I'll write the post opener. Hero ideas: Hosted: "Get up and running in minutes." Dedicated: "Throughput you can commit to." Private: "Inference inside your network." Short subheads under each to call out the primary signal (speed / predictability / compliance).
Noah (Design): I'll build three hero frames and one shared components system (benchmarks, CTA rows). We should avoid heavy numbers on public pages. Use abstract visuals: latency curves, capacity pools, locked shield for private.
Tess (Sales Ops): Routing rules: Hosted CTA -> self-serve funnel + product emails; Dedicated CTA -> AE queue "Enterprise-Reserved"; Private CTA -> security screening form then AE. Add a dropdown on the webinar reg: "Which mode are you evaluating?" that sets contact owner.
Priya (Growth): Good. Also: gated benchmark kit accessible after webinar sign-up. Use it to qualify: ask monthly token estimate and primary workload. Those map to SDR tags.
Evan (PMM): Webinar outline suggestion: 1) Why serving matters (5m) 2) Runtime demo (10m) 3) Benchmark stories + methodology (10m) 4) Dedicated & Private deep-dive (15m) 5) Q&A (20m). Keep the benchmarks defensible.
Lina (Content): For the benchmark narrative, we'll say: "Verified performance profiles across curated model buckets; see the full methodology in the gated kit." In the webinar we'll show concrete p50/p95 latency plots and throughput numbers for sample workloads.
copy-bot: Note: webinar page will auto-add `utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_source=post` to demo CTAs.
Tess (Sales Ops): Can we also add hidden param `mode_hint` on CTA clicks so we don't rely only on form choices? Example mapping in staging: `?mode_hint=hosted` or `?mode_hint=dedicated` or `?mode_hint=private`.
Noah (Design): Thumbs up. I'll add tracking to CTA components and create visual variants for the A/B: A = speed-first hero, B = cost-predictability hero.
Priya (Growth): A/B plan: Run headline A/B on the Hosted and Dedicated pages for 10 days. Primary KPI = webinar signups + demo clicks. Secondary KPI = bounce rate on landing.
Evan (PMM): Messaging checklist for each page: 1) single-sentence hero, 2) 3 short bullets (what you get), 3) one benchmark teaser + CTA to gated kit, 4) customer signal (logo row or quote), 5) FAQ accordion. Keep developer-first tone.
Lina (Content): Microcopy suggestions under CTAs: Hosted: "Start free — no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity — talk to sales"; Private: "Request private eval — security first".
Tess (Sales Ops): Workflow: webinar registrants who pick Dedicated/Private get AE slack alert and HubSpot task within 4 hours. Hosted picks go into automated nurture sequence. Also capture estimated tokens to help prioritize follow-up.
copy-bot: Reminder: create HubSpot form fields: `mode_interest`, `monthly_tokens_bucket`, `primary_use_case`. Campaign id will be `tri_mode_launch_2026`.
Noah (Design): Quick ask: Lina, can you keep the hero verbs consistent across modes? That helps A/B analysis. Example verbs: Start / Reserve / Request.
Lina (Content): Yep. I'll push 6 headline variants (2 per mode) into the deck by noon.
Priya (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 10am PT, design comps by tomorrow 6pm, QA Wed, soft launch Thurs EOD, webinar next Tuesday. I'll compile routing matrix and publish it here after copy freeze.
Evan (PMM): For the launch post meta: keep it short, embed webinar CTA mid-article, and include an anchor to each mode page. Also add a tweet-sized summary for socials.
Tess (Sales Ops): I'll share AE queue assignments and HubSpot workflow after copy freeze. Need final CTA id values to wire event tracking.
Priya (Growth): Final note: avoid over-claiming on the public page. Use gated assets for the heavy numbers. Also we should include an explicit privacy note on the Private page about data residency.
Noah (Design): Got it. I'll upload updated comps to the doc and tag everyone when ready. :rocket:
Lina (Content): Pushing copy now. Please flag anything that reads too marketing-y; we want dev-first clarity.
Priya (Growth): Thanks team — last call for edits. If none, I'll lock the runbook at copy freeze and open tasks in Asana. :white_check_mark:
